method: Exact dense enumeration of the two-country model (10x10 term law), one law per grid point; src.finance.analysis.term_law / metrics. No sampling.

units.joint_exhaustion: probability both bonds exhausted in one 3-year term
units.exceed: probability the pool's total loss exceeds US$80m in one term
units.delivered: share of expected claims paid by one shared US$80m limit
